 How to Watch 76ers vs Hornets
 When: Saturday, October 31, 2026
 Time: 6:00 PM ET
 TV Channel: NBA TV, NBC Sports Philadelphia
 Live Stream: Fubo ( try for free )
 Philadelphia enters the matchup with a 5-1 record after defeating the New York Knicks 98-93 on Friday night. Tyrese Maxey has been outstanding to begin the season, averaging more than 28 points per game, while Joel Embiid continues to provide a dominant presence in the paint. The 76ers have won four of their last five games and will look to keep rolling despite playing on the second night of a back-to-back. With plenty of star power and championship aspirations, Philadelphia has quickly established itself as one of the teams to watch in the Eastern Conference.
 Charlotte enters Saturday’s contest looking to bounce back after consecutive losses to Detroit and Washington. Brandon Miller has been a bright spot for the Hornets, averaging more than 24 points per game, but injuries have created challenges for the team’s supporting cast. Charlotte will need a strong defensive performance and efficient scoring to keep pace with Philadelphia’s talented lineup. The Hornets will have home-court advantage when the teams tip off at 6 p.m. ET on NBA TV.
